action.hypothesis: The top diffusion-ensemble candidates (both [4,3] additions and the [5,3] addition) will retain their leakage reduction under the independent GenVR/CFM response operator, keeping relative risk below the baseline and passing the 1.0 threshold gate.
action.expected_observation: GenVR/CFM evaluations for the three promoted signatures show lower far-field risk than the CFM baseline with consistency z within tolerance, confirming at least one candidate to advance toward exact-local MC.
action.decision_reason: The evidence_queue lists six diffusion candidates awaiting GenVR and no higher-fidelity data exists; closing the next fidelity gate on the best-performing distinct designs (20d0b63a8068, fed6d69cffdf, 142baa0b6175) is the most informative use of the finite GenVR budget before committing to exact MC.

action.hypothesis: The two lowest-risk GenVR/CFM-approved candidates will retain reduced far-field neutron flux, CVaR90, maximum, and worst-sector leakage under the independent exact-local-MC response operator, falsifying the CFM ranking if they fail.
action.expected_observation: Exact-local-MC evaluations of 20d0b63a8068 and fed6d69cffdf show absolute far-field metrics below the exact baseline with relative risk under 1.0, preserving the current CFM ordering.
action.decision_reason: The highest-fidelity evidence gap is exact-local falsification: three candidates already passed GenVR/CFM and await exact testing, while two exact slots remain. Spend the exact budget on the top two GenVR-approved signatures before any unbiased-MC certification.

action.hypothesis: The Exact-approved candidate 20d0b63a8068 retains a real far-field neutron-flux reduction under independent analog and GenVR-weight-window Monte Carlo, with candidate-minus-baseline far-field statistics significantly negative.
action.expected_observation: Unbiased-MC far-field CVaR90, maximum, and worst-sector means for 20d0b63a8068 fall below baseline with 95% intervals separated and consistency z within tolerance across replicates.
action.decision_reason: Exact budget is exhausted and the highest-fidelity open gap is unbiased-MC certification; 20d0b63a8068 has the strongest GenVR risk and passed exact testing, so certifying it now with 4 replicates x 2500 histories meets the verifier contract while preserving histories for the second awaiting candidate.
